name: kennel-hound-delegation
description: Delegate work to appropriate Kennel hound based on task type
steps: Identify task type: Research, Code, Trading, Verification, etc.
Match to hound: Tracker for verification, Programmer for code, Budger for trading
Check hound WAKE.md for current status and capabilities
Formulate clear task with context and acceptance criteria
Submit to hound via subagent or direct message
Track in Corraler or Pupper weekly checks
examples: Programmer: Review this code for security
Budger: Execute this trade if conditions met
